findings.title: Pause menu item can never appear from the list view
findings.body: The pause item is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. The list view now passes only `promRule` (GrafanaRuleListItem renders RuleActionsButtons with no `rule`), so `rulerRule` is undefined and the item is hidden even when `canPause` is true from the Grafana prom-rule ability. The new Grafana abilities are computed but the pause action is unreachable in the list view.

findings.title: Delete menu item is hidden in the list view even when the user is allowed to delete
findings.body: The delete item requires `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the alert list view `rulerRule` is always undefined, so the item is never rendered even when `grafanaDeleteAllowed` is true. The new promRule-based delete ability is therefore dead in the list, and users cannot delete Grafana rules from the list view despite the PR's stated intent.

findings.title: Silence menu item shown in list view but does nothing
findings.body: `canSilence` now includes the promRule-based ability, so the Silence item renders in the list. Its handler calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)`, but RuleActionsButtons.V2 only renders `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` holds, and `rule` is undefined in the list view. Clicking Silence silently does nothing.

findings.title: Rule link drops the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The removed GrafanaRuleLoader built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })` using createReturnTo(). The new GrafanaRuleListItem drops returnTo, so opening a rule from the list no longer lets the user return to the filtered list view.

findings.title: Tests do not cover Pause/Delete/Silence through the promRule path
findings.body: The RBAC tests mock the ability hooks and only check Edit and Delete visibility in the table. Nothing verifies that the Delete, Pause, or Silence menu items actually render or act when only promRule is supplied, which is how the list view uses the component. The bugs above pass the existing test suite.
